headline: IMF Formally Endorses Ghana Economic Recovery Program
summary: The International Monetary Fund issued an endorsement of Ghana's macroeconomic recovery progress, highlighting expanding economic output, moderating inflation, and improving public debt balances.
why: IMF program reviews determine financial disbursements and international sovereign borrowing access for Ghana.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: Positive IMF endorsement strengthens investor confidence in Ghana's fiscal stabilization efforts.
